# bezel-gpui-apple

`gpui_apple` from [zed-industries/zed](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed), republished from the bezel project's fork so that the fork resolves from crates.io rather than from a git dependency.

See [`bezel-gpui`](https://crates.io/crates/bezel-gpui) for the fork's entry point, and [crabtalk/zed](https://github.com/crabtalk/zed) for the source and its patch queue.
